reviews.comment: Prof Lidstrom is one of my favorite profs at Texas A&M. She gets a lot of hate for the poor design of the course, which is not her fault. She is super available outside of class and responds quickly to emails. She is very caring towards her students and genuinely cares about her student's success. Physics is not a fun course but she made it better!

Professor Lidstrom is by far my favorite professor! She did have a rough start to the course ut she quickly got into the groove of the course and always did whatever she could to help her students. PHYS 202 is a hard course, but prof Lidstrom made it bearable. She was always accessible outside of class and responds to emails really quickly!

I loved Lidstrom!!! Her class was tough for me, but thats because im just bad with physics in general, but she was super helpful, and I was able to contact her whenever I needed for help! She gets back quickly, and I will say for this specific class in general the homework is super crucial so dont get behind on it, lab/recitation isnt bad either
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Said she would give us a practice final. Didnt. Said she would curve. Didnt. Never worked practice problems in class. Extended hw deadlines but only after the deadline had already passed and we had wasted all of our attempts trying to rush through problems. Also assigned and graded hw over stuff she hadnt taught us yet

DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR. She refused to curve after telling us all semester that she was going to. I scored higher than what she told me I needed for an A then she gave me a B instead. She told me if I wanted an A I should have asked her to retake homework assignments where I scored lower but she never told us that was an option in class.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Profressor Ford wrote midterms while she wrote the final. She teaches conceptually. The class is test heavy. I put in a lot of work outside to practice math problems because that is what was asked on the midterms. Lets you turn in homework late, kind, and passionate. I will say though physics 2 is a hard subject and she's understanding of that.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Shes nice but her lectures were not helpful to me at all. We barely did practice problems during lecture and had MANY issues with her zoom freezing up which wasted time. I stopped going to SI bc breakout rooms were pointless. She promised to make a practice exam for the final but in the end said she wouldnt make one! Dont know what to expect now
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Lidstrom is very kind and caring and she is obviously passionate about what she teaches. This semester was rough due to it being hybrid (covid) and since it was her 1st time teaching this course, so she was figuring everything out along with us. I think once she organizes the class to her liking, it will be better. Great professor though!

Dr. Lidstrom is an amazing prof. She had a bit of a rough start at the beginning but her lectures are extremely helpful and she really cares about her students. There is homework online that really isn't helpful, but she will extend the deadline it if you don't understand. I took Dr. Ford for PHYS 201 and her lectures are much more engaging.

Dr. Lidstrom is kind and easy to work with. She cares about physics as well as her students. This semester was wack because of covid and it being her first time teaching this course. Any other time the class will be more organized to her liking and it will be all good. Also, the homework was Pearson mastering and not helpful for learning.
